Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Αντίπας Επίσκοπος Περγάμου», with the rank word and the see left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 11 April on pravoslavno.rs, „Свешт. муч. Антипа епископ Пергамски, у Азији.“, with Свешт. муч. left off — the rank words this source uses for a hieromartyr, which this folder already carries in `types` — and with епископ Пергамски, у Азији left off as well: a second rank word and the see with its province, both of which this folder already keeps in `types` and in `office`. The heading leaves no epithet, so the bare forename is what the source gives, and no other folder holds a Serbian Антипа.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in the line for 11 апреля ст. ст., name page 205, «Святитель Антипа Пергамский, епископ, сщмч.», with the rank words and the see left off. The day’s own line gives the name in the genitive. `.tmp/sr-foldpred.mjs` reports the stored form as a key no other folder holds.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 апреля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Антипы , еп. Пергама Асийского (ок. 68).»
source.note: The line stands in the day’s first paragraph and prints a space before its comma because the name is a link. It gives the see as «еп. Пергама Асийского», bishop of Pergamum of Asia, which is the see this folder’s `office` already records, and closes with a year this folder did not hold.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 11 aprilie — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Antipa, Episcopul Pergamului Asiei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Αντίπας Επίσκοπος Περγάμου»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and heads him «(; - 92)»; its third couplet names the day, «Χάλκεον ἑνδεκάτῃ βληθεὶς φλέγῃ, Ἀντίπα, εἰς βοῦν». It prints a long list of relics: the head at the monastery of Panachrantou on Andros, part of the head at the monastery of John the Theologian on Patmos, the right hand at Dionysiou on Athos, the jaw at the Great Lavra, and portions at Dionysiou, Karakallou and Zographou on Athos, at Prousos in Eurytania, at the Gerokomeio of Patras and at Chrysopigi of Divri in Elis, at the Patriarchate of Constantinople, at the metropolitan church of Mytilene and at the church of his name at the University of Athens. Both of its hymns make him the healer of toothache; the day's line gives him no epithet of that kind.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 24.04.2026 (11. април ст. ст.) — „Свешт. муч. Антипа епископ Пергамски, у Азији.“

attestations.note: The day's first of two entries, on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek both keep him on. The man is the same beyond doubt: the Antipas of the Apocalypse, bishop of Pergamum, burned to death inside the brazen bull — and the **92 agrees exactly** with the 92 this folder holds off saint.gr, so **no date was touched**. New to the folder, and the entry is mostly new: the Apocalypse verse given as the Prologue gives it, «Antipas my faithful witness, who was slain among you, where Satan dwells» (2, 13), with the gloss that the place is the city of Pergamum; the state of that city, whose people lived in the dark of idolatry and in utter uncleanness, slaves of the passions, slanderers, violent men, incestuous, in a word the servants of Satan, and where **a man was counted good and righteous who had caught a Christian and killed him**; that their whole religion consisted in divination, the interpretation of dreams, the service of demons and utter debauchery; that **the demons, terrified of Antipas as of fire, appeared to the pagan priests in their sleep and confessed that they feared him and must flee the city because of him**, and that it was the priests who then raised the mob against him; the saint's own answer — when your so-called gods, the masters of the universe, are afraid of me, a mortal man, and must flee this city, do you not know by that alone that your whole religion is a delusion?; that they dragged the old man **before the temple of Artemis**, in front of which stood a bull cast in bronze, heated it with fire and threw the servant of God inside; and that **inside the burning bull he glorified God with thanksgiving, as Jonah once did in the whale and the three youths in the fiery furnace, and prayed for his flock and for the whole world** until his soul parted from the body. The Prologue's own words for him in the city are quoted in quotation marks on the page — „као светлост посред таме, као ружа посред трња, као злато посред блата“, as a light in the midst of darkness, a rose among thorns, gold in the mud. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Surpând înşelăciunile celei doleşti, Sfinţite Mucenice Antipa şi călcând puterea demonilor, cu îndrăznire ai mărturisit pe Hristos înaintea luptătorilor împotriva lui Dumne­zeu. Pentru aceasta făcându-te cetăţean întru cele de sus, împreună cu Cetele îngereşti şi aducând doxologie Stăpânului tuturor, pui înainte şi pentru noi rugăciune de mulţumire dăruindu-ne nouă darul tămăduirilor; drept aceea te cinstim pe tine, Sfinte Sfinţite Mucenice Antipa. Roagă pe Hristos Dumnezeu să mântu­iască sufletele noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Sfințit Mucenic Antipa, Episcopul Pergamului», Glasul 4; the reading «celei doleşti» is the page's own

english.text: Overthrowing the deceits of the idols, O hieromartyr Antipas, and treading down the power of the demons, you confessed Christ boldly before those who fought against God. Therefore, having become a citizen of the world above, offering praise to the Master of all together with the angelic choirs, you set forth prayer of thanksgiving for us also and grant us the gift of healings; and so we honour you, holy hieromartyr Antipas. Entreat Christ God to save our souls.

hymns.text: Μυροβλύτην τὸν θεῖον καὶ μαρτύρων τὸν σύναθλον, τὸν πανευκλεῆ ἱεράρχην καὶ Περγάμου τὸν πρόεδρον, τιμήσωμεν Ἀντίπαν οἱ πιστοί, ὡς τάχιστον καὶ μέγαν ἱατρόν, τῆς δεινῆς ὀδόντων νόσου, καὶ πρὸς αὐτὸν ἀπὸ ψυχῆς βοήσωμεν· Δόξα τῷ σὲ δοξάσαντι Χριστῷ, δόξα τῷ σὲ στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τῷ ἐνεργοῦντι διὰ σοῦ πᾶσιν ἰάματα.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος α’, Τῆς ἐρήμου πολίτης, on the page of Άγιος Αντίπας Επίσκοπος Περγάμου. It is his own and names him and his see.

english.text: The divine myrrh-gusher, the fellow-contestant of the martyrs, the hierarch of all renown and the president of Pergamum — Antipas let us the faithful honour, as the swift and great physician of the dreadful sickness of the teeth, and let us cry to him from the soul: glory to Christ who glorified thee, glory to him who crowned thee, glory to him who through thee works healings for all.

hymns.text: Τόν ἱεράρχην καὶ κλεινόν μεγαλομάρτυρα, τὸν πολιοῦχον τῆς Περγάμου τὀν πανάριστον, καὶ κοινοῦ ἐχθροῦ ἀντίπαλον τὸν Ἀντίπαν, κατὰ χρέος εὐφημήσωμεν ἐν ᾄσμασιν, ὡς τοὺς πάσχοντας ὀδόντας θεραπεύοντα, πόθῳ κράζοντες· Xαίροις, Πάτερ τρισόλβιε.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, Τὴ ὑπερμάχω, on the page of Άγιος Αντίπας Επίσκοπος Περγάμου. It is his own, names him, and plays his name against ἀντίπαλος, the adversary of the common enemy.

english.text: The hierarch and renowned great-martyr, the most excellent guardian of the city of Pergamum, and the adversary of the common enemy — Antipas let us praise in songs as we are bound to do, as one who heals aching teeth, crying to him with longing: rejoice, thrice-blessed father.

hymns.text: Идольския лести упразднил еси, Антипо,/ и, диавольскую поправ силу,/ пред богоборцы дерзновенно Христа исповедал еси./ Темже со Ангельскими чины в Вышних водворяяся,/ Владыце всех славословие принося,/ и о нас молебное благодарение предлагаеши,/ благодать цельбы даруя./ Сего ради тя чтим,/ священномучениче Антипо,/ моли Христа Бога,// да спасет души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 апреля ст. ст. — «Тропарь священномученика Антипы», глас 4, under «Молитвы»
source.note: It names this saint and no other, so it is his own proper and not a hymn mis-hung from a neighbour on the day. Copied out of the page by `.tmp/ru0411/hymns.py` rather than retyped.

english.text: Thou didst bring the deceit of the idols to nothing, O Antipas, and trampling down the power of the devil didst boldly confess Christ before those who fight against God. Therefore, dwelling on high with the ranks of angels, thou offerest praise to the Master of all and settest before Him thanksgiving and supplication for us, bestowing the grace of healing. For this we honour thee, O hieromartyr Antipas: pray to Christ God, that He may save our souls.

hymns.text: Апостолов сопрестольник и святителей украшение/ был еси, блаженне,/ мученически прославився,/ возсиял еси, якоже солнце, всех просвещая,/ Антипо священне,/ разрушил еси безбожия нощь глубокую./ Сего ради тя почитаем,/ яко Божественнаго суща священомученика// и целеб подателя.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 11 апреля ст. ст. — «Кондак священномученика Антипы», глас 4, under «Молитвы»
source.note: It names this saint and no other, so it is his own proper and not a hymn mis-hung from a neighbour on the day. Copied out of the page by `.tmp/ru0411/hymns.py` rather than retyped.

english.text: Thou wast a sharer of the apostles' throne and an adornment of hierarchs, O blessed one; glorified in martyrdom, thou didst shine out like the sun and give light to all, O sacred Antipas, and didst break up the deep night of godlessness. Therefore we honour thee as a divine hieromartyr and a giver of healings.

death.note: **Two calendars, two years, and the interval carries both.** days.pravoslavie.ru’s life: «Он отошел ко Господу спокойно, как бы уснув (+ ок. 68)», and the day line closes «(ок. 68)»; the reign it sets him in is Nero's, «в царствование императора Нерона (54 - 68)». saint.gr: «τότε έδωσε εντολή να τον ρίξουν σε ένα πυρωμένο χάλκινο ομοίωμα βοδιού, όπου τελειώθηκε ο βίος του, το έτος 92 μ.Χ.», and the same page’s heading has «Αγιος Αντιπας Επισκοπος Περγαμου (; - 92)». Nero’s reign ends in the Russian year and the Greek year falls a quarter-century outside it; no third source was read, so neither is chosen. Read 7 October 2026.
